summary: Explicit human Task creation surface (#359): build 6-field Task body with secret redaction, create_task / close_task_with_signal, MCP plate_task_create|close, gh plate task --create|--close.
migration_impact: New MCP tools and CLI subcommand. Agents should create Task issues for human-only blockers instead of trapping work in chat. Agents never complete human work or invent PLATE-TASK-CLOSED.
migration_guidance: 2. When user asks for a human Task or a human-only blocker appears: plate_task_create / gh plate task --create with human_action, why, context, instructions.
3. Optional --epic-milestone / milestone inheritance for Epic-related Tasks (no Epic: label required).
4. After human completes: plate_task_close / --close N posts <!-- PLATE-TASK-CLOSED --> then closes.
agent_notes: Implements #359 explicit creation path. Detection-driven auto Tasks are #360 follow-up. Never paste secrets into Task bodies (redaction is best-effort only).
